description.p: Quark lets you browse, upload, download and share the files in your Proton Drive from a native GNOME app. It works through the official Proton Drive command-line tool, so your files stay end-to-end encrypted and your password is only ever entered on Proton's website.

ul.li: Browse My files, items shared with you, your computers and the trash
Upload with drag and drop, download, rename, move, copy, trash and restore
Share with a link or with people, and answer invitations
Transfers keep going in the background, with a status icon in the top bar

description.p: Quark is not affiliated with or endorsed by Proton AG.
First release: browsing, transfers, sharing, invitations and background mode.
